I started building this free AI chatbot on September 23, 2023, and shared the source so anyone could keep using or remix it at https://github.com/jovylle/chat. It lives openly on Netlify, so every visitor can launch the same Markdown-friendly experience without a hitting a paywall.

It keeps evolving to stay effective and simple: faster replies, clearer quick prompts, and tighter integrations with OpenAI/Anthropic configs so people can plug the tool right into their workflow. The live site at https://chat.uft1.com showcases the latest improvements and lets you try the bot without installing anything.
